pages.title: Temporal Knot
pages.text: A worldline tied in a knot so that an event connects to itself through time. Untying it would make something happen twice. The knot feels tight and tense, and looking at it gives a faint sense of deja vu.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Twisting a backward arrow-of-time shard through a Mobius strip and pinning it with a tachyon crystal in the Chrono Loom, I tied a worldline into a closed knot. Chronon gas kept the loop stable.
